description: Use when you need to know whether a transaction succeeded on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: receipt status, block, confirmations, gas used, effective gas price. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/receipt, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Status and logs of a mined transaction; for the transaction fields (from, to, value, input) use evm_transaction; to check a payment amount use pay_check. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

chain.description: Chain to look the transaction up on; default base

hash.description: Transaction hash (0x + 64 hex); a transaction with no receipt yet (pending) is refused before any charge

name: evm_receipt
title: EVM receipt
